ITEM 1 | Reddish-brown cylindrical slices, roughly 2.5 cm diameter and 1 cm thick, with a smooth, slightly glossy casing and a darker brown rim; several pieces are cut cross-sectionally showing a firm, dense, uniform interior, some pieces halved, scattered in a heap on a white foam plate about 20 cm across | 150
ITEM 2 | Small pale-pink to tan round slices, roughly 1.5 cm across and 0.7 cm thick, with a lighter cut face and a smooth surface, clustered among the larger brown pieces near the center-right of the plate | 25
ITEM 3 | Thick reddish-brown chunk, about 4 cm long and 2 cm wide, with a smooth, slightly shiny skin and a rounded cut end, lying at the lower-left of the pile, dry-looking with no visible liquid | 40
ITEM 4 | Small pale tan cylinder piece, about 2 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, with a lighter interior cut face, sitting near the center-right edge of the pile | 12
